services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: 📍 Highlights: Downtown Dunedin, Pinellas Trail, Waterfront & Honeymoon Island views (Honeymoon Island views with 1 hour Honeymoon Island Tours) Staying in town? Guests at My Blue Cabana get exclusive tour discounts! Ask us how when booking. Experience the beautiful Gulf Coast of Florida by e-bike in our City and Beach tour. Your ride begins at the North border of Dunedin on the Pinellas Trail (a rail-to-trail that stretches over 45 miles from North to South in Pinellas County). During your ride, we'll stop at the Andrews Memorial Chapel, one of the oldest buildings in the area and nearby Butterfly Garden. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enhance your Honeymoon Island e-bike adventure with a deeply relaxing Sunset Sound Bath, led by Jess Griffin of Sacred Soul Sound Healing (http://www.sacredsoulsoundhealing.com). After exploring the island’s natural beauty, settle in on North Beach as the sun melts into the Gulf. Jess creates a calming soundscape using crystal singing bowls and gentle instruments, inviting you to simply lie back, relax, and soak it all in. This is a one-of-a-kind blend of adventure, nature, and relaxation to perfectly end your day in paradise.
